g.text: Aggregate (a) is a MIXED-CHECKPOINT geometric mean over runs from two checkpoints; see the caption and figure manifest for the job provenance.
Per-graph values (b) and the aggregate are distinct and not interchangeable. n=5 per configuration; the per-invocation untimed H1W1A1 warm-up is excluded from the 40 formal rows.
Warp-Cooperative Accumulation is graph-dependent (56438_300801 < 1.0x). Not generalized to roadNet.
